# ============================================================
#  DO NOT EDIT BELOW THIS LINE

def flatten(obj, prefix=""):
    """Recursively flatten a nested dict/list into a flat dict."""
    result = {}
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for k, v in obj.items():
            key = f"{prefix}.{k}" if prefix else k
            if isinstance(v, dict):
                result.update(flatten(v, key))
            elif isinstance(v, list):
                result[key] = ", ".join(str(i) for i in v) if v else ""
            else:
                result[key] = v if v is not None else ""
    return result

# ------ CAMPAIGNS ------

params = {"includeMetrics": "true"}
if USER_EMAIL:
    params["userEmail"] = USER_EMAIL

response = requests.get(
    "https://sourcewhale.app/public-api/v1/campaigns/list",
    headers={"api-key": API_KEY},
    params=params
)

if response.status_code == 401:
    raise Exception("ERROR: Invalid API key. Please check the value in the script.")
elif response.status_code != 200:
    raise Exception(f"ERROR: API returned status {response.status_code}\n{response.text}")

data = response.json()

# Handle different response shapes
if isinstance(data, list):
    campaigns = data
elif isinstance(data, dict):
    campaigns = data.get("campaigns") or data.get("data") or data.get("results") or []
else:
    campaigns = []

# Flatten campaigns into rows
rows = [flatten(c) for c in campaigns]

# Convert to DataFrame for Power BI
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

# Final output for Power BI
df
}
